title: Deerfield Beach pizzeria's vow not to use AI goes viral
source_used: CBS News (CBS Miami), read via Yahoo
key_facts: Munchy's Pizza is a family-owned shop in Deerfield Beach, Florida, known for creative, over-the-top pizza and wing creations.
Owner Munchy Su says he started in the business in 1991.
Last month the shop reached tens of thousands of people with social media posts saying it would not use artificial intelligence.
quote_evidence: Munchy's Pizza is a family-owned mom-and-pop shop in Deerfield Beach
Last month, the shop reached tens of thousands of people through social media posts, claiming it would not use artificial intelligence (AI).
why_it_matters_hint: Shows that a small business's no-AI promise can draw a large online audience.
event_date: Social posts in Sep 2026; CBS Miami report 4 Oct 2026
